jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(I) inventory: Wolcott School District, a town school district in the Orleans Southwest Supervisory Union (member town: Wolcott). Operates K-6.

board.post_note: Wolcott SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected from the floor at the annual meeting on Town Meeting Day.

sources.note: Wolcott Town School District 2026 Annual Meeting Materials (official annual report, via OSSU): p. 2 publishes the board with term ends -- Waring 2027, Morin 2026, LaChance 2027, Davey 2026, Kaiser 2028 (board size five documented three times in the volume; the section 423(b) vote adding two seats is not itself in a fetched document); the 2026 warning (pp. 3-4) Art. 2 puts up exactly one 3-year and one 2-year seat -- the two seats expiring 2026; the certified March 4, 2025 minutes (pp. 22-24) record Davey elected 1-year, LaChance 2-year, Kaiser 3-year, matching the table. Post-election currency: the OSSU superintendent's spring 2026 newsletter lists the same five after the March 3, 2026 meeting ("everyone returned"). RESOLVED 2026-10-29: the March 3, 2026 annual meeting minutes (Minutes of the Annual Town School District Meeting for the Town of Wolcott, Art. 2), supplied by Town Clerk Belinda Harris Clegg by email on 2026-10-28 and read firsthand, record Sheena Davey elected School Director for a term of three years and Melissa Morin elected School Director for a two year term, each by voice vote — Davey end 2029, Morin end 2028, both now set.

directors.name: Roger LaChance
directors.note: Board Clerk (officer role not modeled); elected March 4, 2025 to a 2-year term (certified minutes).

directors.name: Laura Kaiser
directors.note: Elected March 4, 2025 to a 3-year term (certified minutes).

directors.name: Melissa Morin
directors.note: Vice Chair. Elected March 3, 2026 to the two-year term (annual meeting minutes, Art. 2; supplied by Town Clerk Clegg 2026-10-28) — end 2028.

directors.name: Sheena Davey
directors.note: Elected March 3, 2026 to the three-year term (annual meeting minutes, Art. 2; supplied by Town Clerk Clegg 2026-10-28) — end 2029.
